evals.prompt: Can you do an SEO audit on northwindcoffee.com? We're a US coffee roaster trying to rank for 'single origin coffee beans' and 'coffee subscription'. Want to know where we stand vs competitors.
evals.expected_output: A site-wide audit (Mode B): SERP checks for both keywords geo-targeted to the US, on-page analysis of key pages, competitor gap analysis against the top-ranking domains, a health grade and prioritized recommendations.
expectations: The audit runs in site-wide mode (Mode B) and stays within 30 tool calls
Every google_search and google_news call passes a US countryCode
A credit estimate is given to the user before data collection starts
SERP features other than organic results and People Also Ask are reported only when present in the response, otherwise as 'not in SERP data'
The report leads with an executive summary that includes a health grade

evals.prompt: Our blog post at https://www.northwindcoffee.com/blog/pour-over-guide/ used to rank #3 for 'pour over coffee guide' and now it's dropped to like page 3. Can you figure out what happened?
evals.expected_output: A single-page audit (Mode A) on that URL: a SERP check for the keyword including pages 2–3, on-page analysis of the post, a comparison with the current top-ranking pages, and specific recommendations.
expectations: The audit runs in single-page mode (Mode A) and stays within 12 tool calls
Page 2-3 searches use start: 10 / start: 20 and are counted in the call budget
Recommendations name the page and the exact change

evals.prompt: I'm building a new SaaS product, ledgerlite.io. Can you do a quick SEO audit and tell me what keywords the site is going after and whether the on-page SEO is in good shape?
evals.expected_output: Infers target keywords from the homepage and confirms them (or states them as assumptions), asks for or infers the target market, then runs SERP checks and on-page analysis and produces a prioritized recommendation list.
expectations: Target keywords are inferred from the homepage and shown to the user before or alongside the results
The response asks for the target market, or states the US default as an assumption, before running searches
Page scrapes start without render and escalate to render only when content is empty
